entry.cli: core/cli.mjs --root-go ABSOLUTE_JSON --root-go-sha256 HEX --recipe ABSOLUTE_JSON --recipe-sha256 HEX --evidence ABSOLUTE_NEW_DIRECTORY
entry.default: DENY before candidate import, child admission or evidence effects when any authorization is absent
entry.workerModule: export async function runWorker(api) -> result; no top-level effects, child spawn, product import or CLI required

workerApi.request: Deep-frozen JSON {schema:1,job,rootGoSha256,recipeSha256,evidenceRoot,scratchRoot,bindings,deadline:{globalNs,phaseNs,jobNs,workNs},nonce}; decimal monotonic nanoseconds absolute in same host boot clock
workerApi.job: Exact effective336-slot record; stable job.id; runtimeJobId optional; environment source-built-direct|installed-moved-direct|null
workerApi.bindings: Deep-frozen {candidate,sourceRoot,sourceManifest,sourceBuiltRoot,sourceBuiltManifest,installedRoot,packageManifest,toolRoot,toolManifest,typescriptRoot,nodeTypesRoot,undiciTypesRoot,runtimeJobs,diagnosticCatalogue,typePlan,mutantPlan,sourceProofPlan,compiledEntry,toolRequests,buildPlan}; future paths/manifests independently bound by RootGO; stage results expose freshly guarded built paths without granting new origin authority
workerApi.phase: async phase(name, detail={}) -> acknowledged parent event; ordered setup -> admission -> operation -> capture -> cleanup -> complete; optional repeated operation named subevents use note(); begin admission BEFORE imports and operation BEFORE command/compiler
workerApi.note: async note(kind, detail={}) -> acknowledged bounded parent-timestamped event; never changes deadlines
workerApi.writeJson: async writeJson(relativePath, value) -> {path,sha256,bytes}; evidence-relative unique atomic publication only, maximum16MiB, no overwrite
workerApi.writeBytes: async writeBytes(relativePath, Uint8Array) -> {path,sha256,bytes}; evidence-relative unique atomic publication only, maximum16MiB
workerApi.runTool: async runTool({kind:"compiler",configPath,timeoutMs:60000|120000}) -> {code,signal,timedOut,reaped,stdoutPath,stderrPath,stdoutBytes,stderrBytes,stdoutSha256,stderrSha256}; configPath canonical regular under scratch; supervisor derives fixed copied Node/TS argv, guards config/tool trees, maximum one tool in flight; negative compiler result classification belongs inside zero-exit worker; timeout/unknown reap always failure
workerApi.materializePackage: async materializePackage({environment,variant:null|{id,edits:[{path,before,after,count,preSha256,postSha256}]}}) -> {root,manifest,entry,environment,variantId}; full strict regular copy and (B) physical rename; unchanged baseline README; enrolled variant must exactly match RootGO/control plan; source-built basis only after independent build; all copies retained and cumulatively guarded
workerApi.captureSemantic: async captureSemantic({materialization,runtimeJobId}) -> {receipt,capturePath,loaded}; import only through core authenticated candidate loader, fixture/F02 reason scope kept in child; raw durable before return; no semantic assertions
workerApi.assertProjection: async assertProjection({receipt,runtimeJobId}) -> {status:"BOUND_PROJECTION_ONLY"|"INCOMPLETE"|"FAIL",error,obligationsPath}; unchanged F01/CMD22 projection, no full-record success; raw must already exist
workerApi.guard: async guard() -> {integrity:true}; strict source/package/tools/recipe/materializations and evidence membership guards; failures throw unsafe
workerApi.readBoundJson: async readBoundJson(name) -> data; named sealed data in bindings only, not arbitrary paths
workerApi.result: Return {status:"PASS"|"FAIL"|"UNRUN"|"INCOMPLETE",proofRole:string,details:JSON,artifacts?:[{path,sha256,bytes}],stageOutput?:JSON}; only core emits exactly one job receipt. PASS describes role-only proof, never full194/record acceptance. Ordinary asserted failure return FAIL; integrity/admission/loader violations throw with unsafe=true; unknown thrown errors default unsafe. No worker process.exit().

protocol.ipc: {schema:1,nonce,jobId,seq,type,payload}; exact keys; monotonic per sender sequence and independently bound nonce/jobId; supervisor brokers tools, coordinator stamps phase events from process.hrtime.bigint(); no worker timestamp grants time
protocol.workerReceipt: {schema:1,jobId,environment,role,status,details,artifacts,stageOutput,rootGoSha256,recipeSha256}; one RESULT IPC only; stdout never receipts; duplicate/missing/unknown/malformed receipt => FAIL and unsafe if admission integrity unclear
protocol.git: Only exact presealed immutable {revision,path} tuples. Parent derives executable, argv, cwd and environment; no caller-supplied executable or shell.
protocol.spawn: Supervisor owns coordinator, at most one outer and one nested tool concurrently, separate tracked POSIX groups; registered before spawn request acknowledged. Worker may not spawn. Parent supervisor +coordinator +outer +tool =4 maximum processes excluding OS tool internals (none authorized). Node loader thread is not a process.
protocol.reap: TERM at min(slot/phase/global) minus reserved5000ms; KILL after1000ms; known child close AND group absence required within remaining4000ms; unknown/failed reap stops all admissions. Host stalls can defeat wall scheduling; no escaped-descendant/opaque-host-preemption guarantee.

matrix.installedUnmoved: Admission/movement origin only, not third semantic profile

bounds.overflow: No silent truncation; preserve written prefix and explicit failure marker, stop when integrity/completeness unknown
bounds.memory: Bounds on retained buffers/messages, not RSS; JSON hex doubles captured bytes, fixture events and FS snapshots remain bounded. Disk spools process streams without Buffer.concat.

authority.legacyHistoricalMode: Content-only ORIGINAL_MODE_UNATTESTED for explicitly historical prior FINAL-SEAL; excluded executable/admission mode closure; old DENY unchanged
authority.activeClosure: Every code/data projection controlling new execution receives newly sealed mode/hash/size/kind/path and exact parent membership. Root must independently bind expected recipe and GO hashes.

compatibility: Core implementation MUST preserve this v1 interface; incompatible delta requires separately sealed version and root routing, not silent edits.
